name: if
description: Evaluates the triggers if the display_triggers of the limit are met

name: else_if
description: Evaluates the enclosed triggers if the display_triggers of the preceding `if` or `else_if` is not met and its own display_trigger of the limit is met

name: exists
description: Checks if a target scope exists

name: has_civic
description: Checks if the current country has the specified civic

name: is_ruler
description: Checks if scoped leader is the Ruler of the Empire

name: always
description: Sets trigger to be either always true or false

name: has_country_flag
description: Checks if the empire has a specific flag
usage: has_country_flag = <flag> (note: one can use e.g. my_flag@from to track relationships between objects)

name: acquired_specimen_count
description: Returns the country's acquired specimens count

name: additional_crisis_strength
description: Checks the degree to which multiply_crisis_strength effect is increasing the strength of endgame crises
